recall.minute: Images: ViT patches, n = (H/P)(W/P): 224², P = 16 → 196 tokens of 768 numbers; projector 768 → 4096 into the LLM space; interleaved with text; 896² → 3,136 tokens, so tiling/pooling. Audio: encoder frames (20 ms → 500 for 10 s) or codec tokens K × f × t (8 × 75 × 10 = 6,000), enabling speech generation; shared token space for any-to-any models. Context: ~2k → 1M tokens; KV linear (1 → 488 GiB without GQA), attention quadratic (~238,000×); FlashAttention, Ring Attention, RoPE scaling, GQA/MLA, paged caches; test effective use. Frontier: RL-trained reasoning, native tools, computer use, multimodality, long-horizon agents; limits: reliability, cost, oversight. Integrated stack: model, alignment, prompts, RAG, agents, guardrails, serving, evaluation; example 7,080 input + 750 output ≈ $0.0325 per request; caching ≈ $0.026. Frontier risks: misuse, autonomy, deception, over-reliance; dangerous-capability evals, red teaming, staged deployment, system cards.
